verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI is API-first: transcription (async, streaming, sync HTTP), speech analysis, and LLM Gateway are exposed through the API and SDKs, and a public OpenAPI spec exists. However, account and admin settings (model-improvement opt-out, data TTL, BAA, SSO) are documented as dashboard self-serve, with no evidence of API equivalents. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API or management endpoints for account, privacy and SSO settings, and independent confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Gives unified access to frontier language models through the same API
Use the Python or TypeScript SDK to integrate transcription, streaming, and voice agents directly into your own codebase.
opt out of the model improvement program, set a time-to-live for audio and transcripts, and sign a BAA, all self-serve from the dashboard.
